7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: We made our way to the restaurant.

9.speaker: Deivid Wisci (R)
9.text: "King Romus, what an honor to meet you. I'm Deivid Wisci, Foreign Minister of Sordland. Allow me to introduce President Anton Rayne."

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: As Laurento and I were debating the merits of the pasta selection, a gentleman with a kindly demeanor approached us.

147.speaker: Deivid Wisci (R)
147.text: "A splendid idea, Laurento. Let's find a spot where we can talk more comfortably."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Minister Wisci, President Rayne, it's an honor."

150.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
150.text: "Your Majesty, it's a pleasure. And Minister Wisci is too kind – the honor is mine. It's good to meet new faces."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "President Rayne, Minister Wisci, welcome. Let's hope our chat is more satisfying than the lunch selection."

152.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
152.text: "Minister Wisci, President Rayne, shall we take a seat? It might be more conducive for our discussion."

153.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
153.text: "Very glad we ran into each other. Always good to see you Deivid and Mr. Rayne."

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: We moved towards a quieter section of the room, finding a round table that seemed perfect for a more intimate dialogue. We sat down and arranged our plates.

155.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
155.text: "It seems we're all victims of the culinary experiments at this year's conference. I hope the AN general assembly coming up soon will have a better offering."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "One can only hope, President Rayne. The stakes at the general assembly are certainly higher than our lunch choices here."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "Indeed, President Rayne. If the general assembly is as varied and unpredictable as this buffet, we're in for an interesting time."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "They might need some Rizian chefs here, or maybe Sordish ones. Our cuisines do have a reputation for excellence."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "We had much more important things than some food talk I think."

160.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
160.text: "Direct and to the point, Your Majesty. I appreciate that."

161.speaker: Narrator
161.text: We moved towards a quieter section of the room, finding a round table that seemed perfect for a more intimate dialogue. As we sat down, arranging our plates, President Rayne casually addressed the group, lightening the mood.

162.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
162.text: "Don't forget the delights of Sordish cuisine, Your Majesty. Have you ever tried Svabli? It's a Holsord specialty - sheep cheese like you've never tasted it before."

163.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
163.text: "Absolutely, King Romus. Yet, sometimes, these small talks can be a prelude to greater discussions. Like our Zabla back in Bergia, simple on the surface but complex beneath."

164.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
164.text: "An interesting analogy. Much like our traditional Sordish stew, I suppose. Simple ingredients coming together to create something substantial."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "Svabli, you say? I must admit, my experience with Sordish cuisine is limited, but I'm always open to new culinary adventures."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Svabli... I've heard of it but never had the pleasure. It seems our diplomatic meetings could benefit from a taste of Sordland's finest."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "I haven't tried Svabli yet, President Rayne. But it's always fascinating to talk to a food afficionado."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Traditional Sordish stew? I like the blend of various elements, each adding its own unique flavor."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "Your stew analogy is quite fitting. It's about harmony among different ingredients."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "I like the sound of that stew – it's a reminder that something greater than the sum of its parts can emerge from simple beginnings."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "What is Zabla made of? I'm curious."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "Zabla's simplicity yet underlying complexity is intriguing. It's a bit like our Rizetta, a breakfast dish that seems simple but offers a depth of flavors."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "The Zabla analogy is thought-provoking. Never knew you cared so much about dishes, isn't Lespia the big culinary nation in East Merkopa?"

180.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
180.text: "Oh it is super tasty, much better than the pasta we are having here today."

181.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
181.text: "I will see to it that you do next time you visit."

182.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
182.text: "Food reflects a nation's culture – robust and full of character, much like Sordland itself."

183.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
183.text: "I think we can gather for culinary debates at another occassion, timing and proportion are critical. It's not just what we bring to the table, but how and when we present it."
